A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the afforestation with Pinus in Leptosol from highlands in RS, Brazil, has a negative effect on soil chemical attributes, and that the SOM composition in Pinus soils is less labile than the one found in the soil under pasture.
afforestation with Pinus in the highlands of southern Brazil may have negative consequences for the soil quality, especially in the short term.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the afforestation with Pinus species may have a negative impact in the soil quality, which may impair the soil productivity and sustainability.
Pinus afforestation may have negative impacts on soil chemical attributes, especially on SOM quality, and that the effects of afforestation on the SOM quality may be more pronounced with time.
